plugin.name: Garden
plugin.author: Eric
plugin.purpose: Walks the Botanical Gardens maze looking for the Gwillim faeries

muclient.script:
require "aardwolf_colors" require "gmcphelper"
local GMCP_ID = "3e7dedbe37e44942dd46d264"
-- =========================================================== -- The Botanical Gardens -- -- Nine maze rooms (26016-26024) all called "The Botanical Gardens", -- reached by going north out of 26015 - the gate room, which has the -- healer in it. The way out of 26015 is a door: open south, south, -- into The Ballroom. -- -- As with the Garden none of the links inside are hardcoded: they -- are learned by walking and thrown away the moment one that was -- already known leads somewhere else. -- ===========================================================
local MAZE_LO, MAZE_HI = 26016, 26024 local GATE = 26015 -- The Botanical Gardens, healer, the way in and out local BALLROOM = 26007 -- what lies south of the gate, through the door
-- Arriving at the gate from outside puts the mob list up on its own. local AUTO_LIST = { [GATE] = true }
local NAME = {} for v = MAZE_LO, MAZE_HI do NAME[v] = "The Botanical Gardens" end NAME[GATE] = "The Botanical Gardens (gate)"
local DIRS = { "n", "e", "s", "w", "u", "d" }
-- The Gwillim mobs that wander the Gardens. Every one of them is -- noscan except the rabbit, so they are found by walking into their -- room and reading the listing. None of their descriptions contain -- their short name, so ROOMDESC below carries the phrase to look for. local MOBS = { -- name kind noscan { "A cavorting faerie", "hunt", true }, { "A serious faerie", "hunt", true }, { "A gloomy faerie", "hunt", true }, { "A smiling faerie", "hunt", true }, { "A drunken faerie", "hunt", true }, { "A cajoling faerie", "hunt", true }, { "A nibbling rabbit", "hunt", false }, -- the one that does scan }
-- Plain destinations. local PLACES = { { "The gate (healer)", GATE }, }
-- =========================================================== -- Output (x099 brackets / x045 name / white text / x048 values) -- ===========================================================
local CLR_TAG = "#875FFF" local CLR_NAME = "#00D7FF" local CLR_MSG = "#FFFFFF" local CLR_HI = "#00FF87"
local function cnote (s) AnsiNote (stylesToANSI (ColoursToStyles (s))) end
local function note (msg) cnote ("@x099[@x045Garden@x099]@w " .. msg) end
local function warn (msg) cnote ("@x099[@x045Garden@x099]@w @x203" .. msg .. "@w") end
-- =========================================================== -- Mob name matching -- -- Scan gives the short name ("the cloaker"). Roomchars gives the -- long description, which is whatever the builder wrote ("A cloaker -- hovers menacingly."). So we strip the article off the target and -- test for containment, which covers both. -- ===========================================================
local function normalise (s) s = (s or ""):lower () s = s:gsub ("^%s+", ""):gsub ("%s+$", "") s = s:gsub ("^the%s+", ""):gsub ("^an%s+", ""):gsub ("^a%s+", "") return s end
local function matches (line, w) return w and w ~= "" and normalise (line):find (w, 1, true) ~= nil end
-- Not one of these mobs prints its short name in the room, so every -- one of them needs the phrase to look for. Captured in game. -- "(I)(H)(R)(W) A faerie cavorts here with glee." -- "(I)(H)(R)(W) A serious looking lady is here, staring you down." -- "(I)(H)(R) A swirling mist of evil and gloom fills your sight." -- "(I)(H)(R)(W) A smiling faerie watches you approach with mal-intent." -- "(I)(H)(R)(W) A faerie, having quaffed too much mead, flits drunkenly about." -- "(I)(H)(R)(W) A woman stands here, an evil grin on her face." -- "(R) A rabbit is nibbling on flower stems." local ROOMDESC = { ["cavorting faerie"] = "cavorts here with glee", ["serious faerie"] = "serious looking lady", ["gloomy faerie"] = "swirling mist of evil and gloom", ["smiling faerie"] = "smiling faerie watches you approach", ["drunken faerie"] = "quaffed too much mead", ["cajoling faerie"] = "an evil grin on her face", ["nibbling rabbit"] = "rabbit is nibbling on flower stems", }
local DESC_FILE = GetPluginInfo (GetPluginID (), 20) .. "Garden_desc.txt"
local function load_descs () local f = io.open (DESC_FILE, "r") if not f then return end for line in f:lines () do local mob, phrase = line:match ("^%s*(.-)%s*=%s*(.-)%s*$") if mob and phrase and mob ~= "" and phrase ~= "" and mob:sub (1, 1) ~= "#" then ROOMDESC[mob:lower ()] = phrase:lower () end end f:close () end
local function save_descs () local f = io.open (DESC_FILE, "w") if not f then return end f:write ("# Garden room-description overrides. One per line:\n") f:write ("# <normalised mob name> = <phrase to look for in the room>\n") local keys = {} for k in pairs (ROOMDESC) do keys[#keys + 1] = k end table.sort (keys) for _, k in ipairs (keys) do f:write (k .. " = " .. ROOMDESC[k] .. "\n") end f:close () end
-- =========================================================== -- Learned map (identical scheme to the STTNG plugin) -- edges[from][dir] = vnum a link we have walked -- = 0 leads out of the Garden -- = -1 "Alas, you cannot go that way" -- exits[from][dir] = true directions GMCP says the room has -- ===========================================================
local edges, exits = {}, {} local cur = nil
-- Declared up here because absorb_room below marks rooms as visited. local visited = {} -- rooms stood in during the current lap local laps = 0
local menu -- defined down in the commands section; the GMCP -- handler above it needs to be able to call it
local DATA_FILE = GetPluginInfo (GetPluginID (), 20) .. "Garden.dat"
local function link (a, d, b) edges[a] = edges[a] or {} edges[a][d] = b end
local function seed () -- South out of the gate is the door back to The Ballroom. Marking it -- as leading out stops a sweep from ever walking itself out of the -- Gardens. 'gardout' opens and uses it deliberately. link (GATE, "s", 0) end
local function save_map () local f = io.open (DATA_FILE, "w") if not f then return end f:write ("-- Garden learned map. Written by the plugin; safe to delete.\n") f:write ("return {\n edges = {\n") for from, t in pairs (edges) do local parts = {} for d, to in pairs (t) do parts[#parts + 1] = string.format ("[%q]=%d", d, to) end f:write (string.format (" [%d]={%s},\n", from, table.concat (parts, ","))) end f:write (" },\n exits = {\n") for from, t in pairs (exits) do local parts = {} for d in pairs (t) do parts[#parts + 1] = string.format ("[%q]=true", d) end f:write (string.format (" [%d]={%s},\n", from, table.concat (parts, ","))) end f:write (" },\n}\n") f:close () end
local function load_map () edges, exits = {}, {} local f = io.open (DATA_FILE, "r") if f then local body = f:read ("*a") f:close () local chunk = loadstring (body or "") if chunk then local ok, t = pcall (chunk) if ok and type (t) == "table" then edges = t.edges or {} exits = t.exits or {} move_wait = tonumber (t.wait) or move_wait end end end seed () end
local function known_links () local n = 0 for _, t in pairs (edges) do for _, to in pairs (t) do if to > 0 then n = n + 1 end end end return n end
local function absorb_room () local ri = gmcp ("room.info") if type (ri) ~= "table" then return end local num = tonumber (ri.num) if not num then return end cur = num if not NAME[num] then return end visited[num] = true local e = {} if type (ri.exits) == "table" then for d in pairs (ri.exits) do e[d] = true end end if next (e) == nil then for _, d in ipairs (DIRS) do e[d] = true end end exits[num] = e end
-- =========================================================== -- Run state -- ===========================================================
local running = false local phase = nil -- "travel" | "sweep" | "goto" local target = nil -- vnum, for a goto local want = nil -- normalised mob name, for a hunt local want_desc = nil -- phrase to look for in the room listing local want_show = nil -- how to print it local pending = nil -- { from = vnum, dir = d } local queued = {} -- directions still to walk (a scan beeline) local gen = 0 local steps = 0 local scanning = false
local here_mobs = {} -- roomchars for the room we are standing in local rc_open = false local scan_room = nil -- room the outstanding scan was asked from local arrival = 0 -- bumped on every arrival, guards the decision local decided = true -- has this arrival been acted on yet? local rc_blocks = 0 -- how many room listings we have actually seen local rooms_hit = 0 -- how many rooms we have walked into local noscan_mode = false -- all but the rabbit: never scan, walk and look local leaving = false -- gardout: open the door and leave on arrival local rc_warned = false -- only nag about a missing room listing once -- How long to wait for a move to be answered before treating that exit as -- dead. Generous by default: a spurious timeout is far more damaging than -- a slow one, because the exit gets written off. 'gard wait <secs>'. local move_wait = 25
local resyncing = false -- waiting on a GMCP room request after a stall local stalls = 0 -- moves in a row that went unanswered local dump_here = false -- 'gard here' waiting on a room listing local debug_on = false -- 'gard debug': show what the plugin is seeing local scan_hits = {} -- { dir = "n", dist = 2, name = "the roper" } local scan_dir, scan_dist = nil, nil
local sightings = {} -- everything seen this sweep: mob -> vnum
local MAXSTEPS = 600
local function stop (msg, bad) running = false resyncing = false phase = nil pending = nil target = nil want = nil queued = {} scanning = false gen = gen + 1 EnableTriggerGroup ("gd_scan", false) save_map () if msg then if bad then warn (msg) else note (msg) end end end
-- =========================================================== -- Pathfinding over learned links -- ===========================================================
local function bfs (from, goalfn) if goalfn (from) then return {} end local seen, back = { [from] = true }, {} local q, head = { from }, 1 while head <= #q do local r = q[head] head = head + 1 local t = edges[r] if t then for _, d in ipairs (DIRS) do local to = t[d] if to and to > 0 and not seen[to] then seen[to] = true back[to] = { r, d } if goalfn (to) then local path, n = {}, to while n ~= from do local p = back[n] table.insert (path, 1, p[2]) n = p[1] end return path end q[#q + 1] = to end end end end return nil end
local function untried (r) local ex = exits[r] if not ex then return nil end local kn = edges[r] for _, d in ipairs (DIRS) do if ex[d] and not (kn and kn[d]) then return d end end return nil end
-- =========================================================== -- Walking -- ===========================================================
local move, advance, after_arrival
function move (dir) steps = steps + 1 if steps > MAXSTEPS then stop ("Gave up after " .. MAXSTEPS .. " moves.", true) return end pending = { from = cur, dir = dir } Send (dir) DoAfterSpecial (move_wait, "gd_timeout (" .. gen .. ")", 12) end
local function start_scan () scan_hits = {} scan_dir, scan_dist = nil, nil scanning = true scan_room = cur -- so late output from a room we have left is dropped EnableTriggerGroup ("gd_scan", true) Send ("scan") end
-- One decision per arrival. Whichever comes first - the scan finishing -- or this fallback - acts, and the other is ignored. local function schedule_decision (seconds) arrival = arrival + 1 decided = false DoAfterSpecial (seconds, "gd_decide (" .. gen .. "," .. arrival .. ")", 12) end
-- gardout: standing at the gate, open the south door and step through. local function leave_gardens () leaving = false note ("Out through the south door into The Ballroom.") Send ("open s") Send ("s") end
-- Nearest room we have not stood in yet. local function path_to_unvisited () return bfs (cur, function (v) return not visited[v] end) end
-- Arrived somewhere: for a scannable mob, scan and decide when it comes -- back. For the noscan pair scanning is pointless - they never appear in -- it - so we send nothing and decide off the room's own character list, -- with a timer to cover rooms that list nobody at all. local function begin_room () rooms_hit = rooms_hit + 1 if noscan_mode then schedule_decision (2) else start_scan () schedule_decision (8) end end
-- Pick the next direction: finish a beeline, else head for the target -- room, else take an exit we have never tried, else walk to the nearest -- room that still has one. function advance () if #queued > 0 then move (table.remove (queued, 1)) return end
if phase == "goto" then if cur == target then if leaving then stop () leave_gardens () return end stop ("Arrived: @x048" .. (NAME[cur] or cur) .. "@w (@x048" .. cur .. "@w)") return end local path = bfs (cur, function (v) return v == target end) if path and path[1] then move (path[1]) return end end
local d = untried (cur) if d then move (d) return end
local path = bfs (cur, function (v) return untried (v) ~= nil end) if path and path[1] then move (path[1]) return end
if phase == "goto" then stop ("Explored everything I can reach and never found that room. " .. "Try @x048gard reset@w.", true) return end
-- Every exit has been walked. Before calling it, make sure we have -- actually stood in every room we know of - scan reaches into rooms we -- never entered, and the noscan pair only show up if we walk in. local unseen = path_to_unvisited () if unseen and unseen[1] then move (unseen[1]) return end
-- A full lap done. These mobs wander, so one clean lap is not proof it -- is not here - go round once more before giving up. laps = laps + 1 if laps >= 2 then stop ("Walked every room in the maze twice - no sign of @x048" .. (want_show or "it") .. "@w.", true) return end
note ("Every room walked once and no sign of it - going round again in " .. "case it has moved.") visited = { [cur] = true } local again = path_to_unvisited () if again and again[1] then move (again[1]) return end
stop ("Nowhere left to walk - no sign of @x048" .. (want_show or "it") .. "@w.", true) end
-- =========================================================== -- Reshuffle handling -- ===========================================================
local function reshuffled () edges, exits = {}, {} seed () visited, laps = {}, 0 absorb_room () queued = {} warn ("The Garden has reshuffled - dropping the old map and sweeping again.") end
local function record (from, dir, to) edges[from] = edges[from] or {} local old = edges[from][dir] if old and old ~= to then reshuffled () edges[from] = edges[from] or {} end edges[from][dir] = to end
-- =========================================================== -- Did we find it? -- ===========================================================
-- A room-listing or scan line that is the mob we are after. Checks the -- short name first, then the room-description phrase, because the two -- do not always share any words. local function is_target (line) if matches (line, want) then return true end if matches (line, want_desc) then return true end return false end
local function found_here () stop () note ("@x048" .. (want_show or "it") .. "@w is @x048right here@w - " .. NAME[cur] .. " (@x048" .. tostring (cur) .. "@w).") end
-- Called once the scan for this room has finished, so both the room's -- character list and the scan results are in. function after_arrival () if not running then return end
-- A noscan hunt is blind without the room's character list. Plenty of -- rooms are simply empty, so this is a warning and not a reason to give -- up - but 30 rooms without a single listing means the tag is not on. if noscan_mode and rc_blocks == 0 and rooms_hit >= 30 and not rc_warned then rc_warned = true warn ("30 rooms and not one room character list from the MUD - that " .. "tag looks off, and without it @x048" .. (want_show or "it") .. "@w cannot be spotted. Check with @x048gard here@w.") end
-- 1. Standing in the same room as it. This is the only thing that -- ever finds the noscan pair. for _, line in ipairs (here_mobs) do if is_target (line) then found_here () return end end
-- 2. Scan picked it up somewhere nearby - beeline straight to it. for _, hit in ipairs (scan_hits) do sightings[hit.name] = cur if is_target (hit.name) then -- Only beeline if that exit actually works for us. Scan sees through -- exits we have found to be dead, and blindly re-issuing one turns -- into a stall every time the same sighting comes back. local known = edges[cur] and edges[cur][hit.dir] if known ~= -1 then note ("Scan has @x048" .. want_show .. "@w " .. hit.dist .. " " .. hit.dir .. " - going to it.") queued = {} for _ = 1, hit.dist do queued[#queued + 1] = hit.dir end advance () return end if debug_on then note ("scan shows it " .. hit.dist .. " " .. hit.dir .. " but that exit is dead from here - going round.") end end end
-- 3. Nothing here, keep sweeping. advance () end
-- =========================================================== -- Trigger handlers -- ===========================================================
function gd_blocked () if not running or not pending then return end local from, dir = pending.from, pending.dir pending = nil gen = gen + 1 queued = {} -- a beeline that walks into a wall is void edges[from] = edges[from] or {} edges[from][dir] = -1 advance () end
function gd_rc_start () rc_blocks = rc_blocks + 1 here_mobs = {} rc_open = true EnableTriggerGroup ("gd_rc", true) end
-- Check the moment the room listing closes rather than waiting for the -- scan to come back. The two noscan mobs only ever show up here, and -- this way it does not matter which of the two arrives first. function gd_rc_end () rc_open = false EnableTriggerGroup ("gd_rc", false) if debug_on then note ("@x048roomchars@w: " .. #here_mobs .. " line(s) in room " .. tostring (cur)) for _, l in ipairs (here_mobs) do ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", " |", CLR_MSG, "", l) end if want or want_desc then ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", " looking for name '", CLR_HI, "", tostring (want), CLR_TAG, "", "' or description '", CLR_HI, "", tostring (want_desc), CLR_TAG, "", "'") end end
if dump_here then dump_here = false note ("This room's character list:") if #here_mobs == 0 then ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", " (nothing listed)") end for _, l in ipairs (here_mobs) do ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", " " .. l) end end if not running or not (want or want_desc) then return end for _, line in ipairs (here_mobs) do if is_target (line) then found_here () return end end -- Not here. For a noscan hunt the listing is all we were waiting on, -- so move on now rather than sitting out the fallback timer. if noscan_mode and not decided then decided = true after_arrival () end end
function gd_rc_line (name, line) if not rc_open then return end -- room listings are prefixed with flag groups like "(H) " line = line:gsub ("^%s*", "") while true do local rest = line:match ("^%b()%s*(.*)$") or line:match ("^%[[^%]]*%]%s*(.*)$") if not rest then break end line = rest end here_mobs[#here_mobs + 1] = line end
function gd_scan_start () scan_hits = {} scan_dir, scan_dist = nil, nil EnableTriggerGroup ("gd_scan", true) end
function gd_scan_here () scan_dir, scan_dist = nil, nil end
function gd_scan_dir (name, line, wc) scan_dist = tonumber ((wc[1] or ""):match ("%d")) or 1 scan_dir = (wc[2] or ""):sub (1, 1):lower () end
function gd_scan_mob (name, line, wc) local mob = wc[1] or "" -- strip the leading flag groups scan puts before the name mob = mob:gsub ("^%s*", "") while true do local rest = mob:match ("^%b()%s*(.*)$") or mob:match ("^%[[^%]]*%]%s*(.*)$") if not rest then break end mob = rest end if scan_dir and scan_dist then scan_hits[#scan_hits + 1] = { dir = scan_dir, dist = scan_dist, name = mob } else here_mobs[#here_mobs + 1] = mob -- "Right here you see:" end end
function gd_scan_end () EnableTriggerGroup ("gd_scan", false) if debug_on then note ("@x048scan@w: " .. #scan_hits .. " hit(s) from room " .. tostring (cur)) for _, h in ipairs (scan_hits) do ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", " |", CLR_MSG, "", h.dist .. " " .. h.dir .. " " .. h.name) end end if not running or not scanning then return end scanning = false if scan_room ~= cur then return end -- output from a room we have left if decided then return end decided = true after_arrival () end
-- If no {roomchars} block ever arrives, the tag is not on - and that -- would mean the noscan mobs can never be spotted. Say so plainly. function gd_here_timeout () if not dump_here then return end dump_here = false warn ("No room listing came back. The MUD is not sending {roomchars}, " .. "so nothing can spot the noscan mobs. Try @x048tags roomchars on@w " .. "by hand and run @x048gard here@w again.") end
-- A move went unanswered. Deliberately does NOT re-send it - that walked -- us an extra room and desynchronised the whole sweep. Instead ask the -- MUD where we actually are and carry on from there. One dead exit is -- not a reason to abandon the sweep: an exit that loops straight back -- into the room you left produces no room change at all, and there is no -- point ever trying it again either way. function gd_timeout (g) if not running or g ~= gen or not pending then return end
if phase == "travel" then stop ("Could not get into the Garden. Walk in yourself and try again.", true) return end
local from, dir = pending.from, pending.dir pending = nil queued = {} -- a beeline whose step failed is meaningless stalls = stalls + 1
if stalls > 8 then stop ("Eight moves running went unanswered - stopping. The MUD is " .. "probably badly lagged; try again in a moment.", true) return end
edges[from] = edges[from] or {} if not edges[from][dir] then edges[from][dir] = -1 end
if debug_on then note ("stall on '@x048" .. dir .. "@w' from room @x048" .. tostring (from) .. "@w after " .. move_wait .. "s - marking it dead and resyncing.") end
resyncing = true Send_GMCP_Packet ("request room") DoAfterSpecial (6, "gd_resync_timeout (" .. gen .. ")", 12) end
function gd_resync_timeout (g) if not running or g ~= gen or not resyncing then return end resyncing = false stop ("The MUD did not answer a room request either - stopping. Run it " .. "again once things are moving.", true) end
function gd_decide (g, seq) if not running or g ~= gen or seq ~= arrival or decided then return end decided = true after_arrival () end
-- =========================================================== -- GMCP -- ===========================================================
function OnPluginBroadcast (msg, id, bname, text) if id ~= GMCP_ID then return end
if text == "char.status" then if not running then return end local st = gmcp ("char.status") if type (st) == "table" and tonumber (st.state) == 8 then stop ("In combat - stopped. @x048gard@w again when you are clear.", true) end return end
if text ~= "room.info" then return end local ri = gmcp ("room.info") if type (ri) ~= "table" then return end local num = tonumber (ri.num) if not num then return end
local was = cur absorb_room ()
-- Just come in: show the list without being asked. Only when we have -- arrived from outside, so sweeping through these rooms stays quiet. if AUTO_LIST[num] and not NAME[was] and not running then menu () end
if not running then return end
if phase == "travel" then if NAME[num] then phase = (target and "goto") or "sweep" pending = nil if phase == "goto" then advance () else begin_room () end end return end
if resyncing then resyncing = false pending = nil begin_room () -- note: stalls is NOT cleared here; only a real return -- move arriving counts as recovery end
if not pending then return end local from, dir = pending.from, pending.dir pending = nil stalls = 0
if not NAME[num] then record (from, dir, 0) stop ("Left the Garden (now in room " .. num .. ") - stopped.", true) return end
record (from, dir, num)
if phase == "goto" then advance () else begin_room () end end
-- =========================================================== -- Commands -- ===========================================================
local function begin (kind, tgt, mobname, noscan, want_out) if running then stop () end absorb_room ()
steps = 0 queued = {} sightings = {} visited = {} laps = 0 gen = gen + 1 running = true pending = nil target = (kind == "goto") and tgt or nil noscan_mode = noscan and true or false leaving = want_out and true or false resyncing = false stalls = 0 rc_warned = false rc_blocks = 0 rooms_hit = 0 want = mobname and normalise (mobname) or nil want_desc = want and ROOMDESC[want] or nil want_show = mobname
-- Make sure the two tagged outputs we depend on are actually on, so -- this works whether or not Search_and_Destroy is loaded. SendNoEcho ("tags scan on") SendNoEcho ("tags roomchars on")
if kind == "goto" then note ("Heading for @x048" .. (NAME[tgt] or tgt) .. "@w (@x048" .. tgt .. "@w).") elseif noscan then note ("Hunting @x048" .. mobname .. "@w. It is @x048noscan@w - no " .. "scanning at all, just walking every room and reading it.") else note ("Hunting @x048" .. mobname .. "@w - scanning as I sweep.") end
if NAME[cur] then phase = (kind == "goto") and "goto" or "sweep" if phase == "goto" then advance () else -- Nothing has printed this room for us, so ask for it once. Without -- this, a noscan mob standing in the room you start in gets missed. SendNoEcho ("look") begin_room () end else phase = "travel" note ("Not in the Gardens - taking you to the gate first.") Execute ("mapper goto " .. GATE) DoAfterSpecial (30, "gd_entry (" .. gen .. ")", 12) end end
function gd_entry (g) if not running or g ~= gen or phase ~= "travel" then return end if NAME[cur] then return end -- the room.info handler has taken over stop ("The mapper did not get me to The Botanical Gardens (" .. GATE .. "). Walk to the gate yourself and try again.", true) end
-- gardout from anywhere: walk back to the gate, then out through the door. function gd_out () absorb_room () if not NAME[cur] then note ("You are not in the Gardens - nothing to walk out of.") return end begin ("goto", GATE, nil, false, true) end
function menu () note ("The Botanical Gardens - click a mob to hunt it:") local n = 0 ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", " -- wanders the maze --") for _, m in ipairs (MOBS) do n = n + 1 if m[2] == "hunt" then ColourTell (CLR_TAG, "", " ") Hyperlink ("gard " .. n, string.format ("%2d", n), "Hunt " .. m[1], CLR_HI, "black", 0, 1) ColourTell (CLR_TAG, "", " ") Hyperlink ("gard " .. n, m[1], "Hunt " .. m[1], CLR_MSG, "black", 0, 1) if m[3] then ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", string.rep (" ", math.max (1, 26 - #m[1])) .. "noscan - found by walking into it") else ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", "") end end end local anyfixed = false for _, m in ipairs (MOBS) do if m[2] == "goto" then anyfixed = true end end if anyfixed then ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", " -- fixed spot --") end n = 0 for _, m in ipairs (MOBS) do n = n + 1 if m[2] == "goto" then ColourTell (CLR_TAG, "", " ") Hyperlink ("gard " .. n, string.format ("%2d", n), "Walk to " .. m[1], CLR_HI, "black", 0, 1) ColourTell (CLR_TAG, "", " ") Hyperlink ("gard " .. n, m[1], "Walk to " .. m[1], CLR_NAME, "black", 0, 1) ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", string.rep (" ", math.max (1, 26 - #m[1])) .. "room " .. m[4]) end end ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", " -- rooms --") for i, p in ipairs (PLACES) do local k = #MOBS + i ColourTell (CLR_TAG, "", " ") Hyperlink ("gard " .. k, string.format ("%2d", k), "Walk to " .. p[1], CLR_HI, "black", 0, 1) ColourTell (CLR_TAG, "", " ") Hyperlink ("gard " .. k, p[1], "Walk to " .. p[1], CLR_MSG, "black", 0, 1) ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", string.rep (" ", math.max (1, 26 - #p[1])) .. "room " .. p[2]) end ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", " " .. known_links () .. " links learned. gard <any mob name> / stop / seen / map / reset / help") end
local function pick (n) local m = MOBS[n] if m then if m[2] == "goto" then begin ("goto", m[4], m[1]) else begin ("hunt", nil, m[1], m[3]) end return end local p = PLACES[n - #MOBS] if p then begin ("goto", p[2], nil) return end warn ("There is no entry " .. tostring (n) .. ". Type @x048gard@w.") end
local function show_seen () local any = false note ("Mobs scanned during the last sweep:") for mob, room in pairs (sightings) do any = true ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", " " .. mob, CLR_TAG, "", " seen from room " .. room) end if not any then ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", " (nothing yet - run a hunt first)") end end
local function show_map () note ("Learned links (" .. known_links () .. "):") local vnums = {} for v in pairs (edges) do vnums[#vnums + 1] = v end table.sort (vnums) for _, from in ipairs (vnums) do local parts = {} for _, d in ipairs (DIRS) do local to = edges[from][d] if to == 0 then parts[#parts + 1] = d .. "->out" elseif to == -1 then parts[#parts + 1] = d .. "->wall" elseif to then parts[#parts + 1] = d .. "->" .. to end end if #parts > 0 then ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", " " .. from .. " ", CLR_HI, "", table.concat (parts, " ")) end end end
local function show_help () local lines = { "gard - the clickable mob and room list", "gard <n> - hunt / walk to entry <n>", "gard <mob name> - hunt any mob by name, listed or not", "gardout - back to the gate, then open south and out", "gard stop - stop the sweep", "gard seen - what the last sweep scanned, and where", "gard map - links learned so far", "gard reset - forget the map and sweep from scratch", "gard here - show what this room lists, flags stripped", "gard debug - echo every room listing and scan as it arrives", "gard wait <secs> - how long to wait on a move before writing that", " exit off (default 25)", "gard desc - show the room-description overrides", "gard desc <mob> = <phrase> - teach it how a mob reads in a room", "", "Only the rabbit can be scanned, and for it the sweep scans each", "room and walks straight to it the moment scan reports it. The six faeries are noscan, and", "none of the seven print their short name in the room, so each is", "matched on a phrase from its room description instead - use", "'gard here' then 'gard desc' if one ever reads differently.", "", "The maze reshuffles on repop. You do not have to say so - the first", "link that leads somewhere new wipes the map and it starts again.", } note ("The Garden sweeper") for _, l in ipairs (lines) do ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", " " .. l) end end
function gd_command (name, line, wildcards) local arg = (wildcards[1] or ""):gsub ("^%s+", ""):gsub ("%s+$", "")
if arg == "" then menu () return end
local n = tonumber (arg:match ("^(%d+)$")) if n then pick (n) return end
if arg == "out" then gd_out () return end
if arg == "debug" then debug_on = not debug_on note ("Debug is now @x048" .. (debug_on and "on" or "off") .. "@w.") return end
if arg == "here" then -- Ask the MUD to print this room again and show what it lists, so a -- mob whose description does not match its name can be pinned down. dump_here = true here_mobs = {} SendNoEcho ("tags roomchars on") SendNoEcho ("look") DoAfterSpecial (3, "gd_here_timeout ()", 12) return end
local w = arg:match ("^wait%s+(%d+)$") if w then move_wait = math.max (5, math.min (120, tonumber (w))) save_map () note ("Will wait @x048" .. move_wait .. "@w seconds for a move to be " .. "answered before writing that exit off.") return end if arg == "wait" then note ("Currently waiting @x048" .. move_wait .. "@w seconds per move. " .. "Change it with @x048gard wait <seconds>@w.") return end
local dmob, dphrase = arg:match ("^desc%s+(.-)%s*=%s*(.+)$") if dmob then ROOMDESC[normalise (dmob)] = dphrase:lower () save_descs () note ("Noted: @x048" .. dmob .. "@w is recognised in a room by \"@x048" .. dphrase .. "@w\".") return end if arg == "desc" then note ("Room-description overrides:") for k, v in pairs (ROOMDESC) do ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", " " .. k, CLR_TAG, "", " -> ", CLR_HI, "", v) end ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", " set one with: gard desc <mob> = <phrase>") return end
if arg == "stop" then if running then stop ("Stopped.") else note ("Not sweeping.") end elseif arg == "seen" then show_seen () elseif arg == "map" then show_map () elseif arg == "reset" then stop () edges, exits = {}, {} seed () save_map () note ("Map forgotten. The next sweep starts from scratch.") elseif arg == "help" then show_help () else -- anything else is a mob name - hunt it whether it is on the list or not local noscan = false for _, m in ipairs (MOBS) do if normalise (m[1]) == normalise (arg) then noscan = m[3] end end begin ("hunt", nil, arg, noscan) end end
-- ===========================================================
function OnPluginInstall () load_map () load_descs () absorb_room () note ("Loaded. Type @x048gard@w for the list. " .. known_links () .. " links remembered.") end
function OnPluginClose () save_map () end function OnPluginDisable () stop () end
